business_model.basis: Stated in the 20-F MD&A (P3) and confirmed by the segment lines in the income statement (F2).
business_model.claim: Chagee is a premium freshly-made tea drinks brand that generates revenue through two operating models: franchised teahouses (supplying products and charging service fees to franchise partners) and company-owned teahouses (selling tea drinks directly to consumers).
quotes: We generate revenues mainly from amounts received from our franchised teahouses for sales of products and services under our franchise arrangements, and to a lesser extent, sales of freshly-made tea drinks directly to consumers by our company-owned teahouses.

business_model.basis: Stated in P3 MD&A; figures match the F2 income-statement segment lines.
business_model.claim: Franchised teahouses accounted for 88.5% of total net revenues in FY2025 (RMB 11,417,091 thousand), down from 93.8% in FY2024, as the company-owned segment grew faster.
quotes: In the years ended December 31, 2023, 2024 and 2025, 94.7%, 93.8% and 88.5% of our total net revenues were generated from our franchised teahouses, respectively.

business_model.basis: Stated in P3 MD&A revenue-breakdown section.
business_model.claim: Franchise revenue has two components: (i) sales of products (raw materials such as tea leaves and dairy, packaging, and teahouse equipment) and (ii) franchising and other services (monthly royalties as a percentage of franchisee income or profit, fixed initial franchise fees, and annual brand license fees).
quotes: We generate net revenues from sales of products by supplying raw materials, such as tea leaves and dairy, as well as packaging materials used to make our tea drinks, to our franchised teahouses.

net revenues from franchising and other services were generated from service fees that we receive from our franchise partners pursuant to our franchise contracts, which primarily include (a) monthly royalties typically computed by applying a fixed percentage to the monthly income, or, in certain instances, to the monthly profit generated by a franchised teahouse, (b) fixed initial franchise fees and (c) annual brand license fees.

business_model.basis: Stated in P3 MD&A; corroborated by F2 segment lines (¥1,490,316 thousand revenue, ¥989,359 thousand operating costs).
